svg.aria-label: Grid of 1,833 squares, one per day of continuous video. 200 squares mark what reached defendants, 583 mark what was said to exist, the rest is the remainder of the 44,000 hour total.
svg.text: Every square is one full day of continuous video. All 1,833 of them.
YEARS, IF YOU NEVER LOOKED AWAY
What I was told existed while I wrote this report.
Existed the whole time. I never saw a frame of it.
In February 2023 my own motion put 41,000 hours on the record. In November 2023 the House began releasing 44,000. And that is only what has been tracked and recovered.
